# Independent plan-02 approval with denominator composition

All 12 full staged entries and every question, answer, lead, table, embedded supplement, example and variant were read. All 53 author spans were replayed from the frozen originals and reproduce the frozen proposal exactly; thus no unlisted rewriting is hidden in the replacement leaves. Every authentic question, item ID, metadata field and original numeric token remains. Adjacent duplicate headings preserve their anchored first copy; duplicate authored opening paragraphs preserve their complete text in the answer prefix/lead. All author manifest file hashes match the supplied frozen manifest.

## Decisions and proofs
- AI usage (11 questions): personal usage claims are neutral interview frameworks, model names remain historical examples, forecasts remain predictions, model capacity is not approval for high-risk operations. Stronger model wording in both answer and independently visible lead is qualified by validation, authority and human review. Figma is a conceptual workflow discussion, not a current product capability guarantee.
- AI code quality (2 questions): full chapter 8 supplement retained, with task granularity, ownership, tests, independent review, integration and limitations. It never claims test success proves all behavior. The function table remains a draft requiring contracts and failure/state analysis.
- Agent engineering (2 questions): full measurement/product supplement retained; task difficulty and developer experience confound historical speed comparisons, fixed-model/system comparisons isolate different changes. Evaluation preference is an interview argument, not universal safety certification.
- Git collaboration (2 questions): save working changes before synchronization; team policy chooses merge/rebase; shared history is not rewritten without agreement. No executed command or external-write claim.
- Nine balls: independently simulated all 18 hidden ball/direction states via physical weighings and found exactly one compatible state after three results. The eight-heavy-ball two-weighing construction and lower bound are valid. Nine-ball identity-only two-weighing lower bound separately considers k<=3 balanced branches and k=4 unbalanced branch; it does not misuse 18>9 when direction is not required.
- Abstract pieces: for any hidden A position, taking half of each gives A/2+B, supplemented by known A/2. Without added known A, guaranteeing one A for all assignments forces all three fractions to 1 and therefore two B. Explicitly abstract and unsuitable for actual medication decisions.
- Alternating coin: finite-horizon mass checked for 25 rational (p,q) pairs and eight horizons, with A-win+B-win+unresolved=1. Infinite formula requires 1-(1-p)(1-q)>0. Added this domain explicitly to BOTH answer opening and separately visible lead, preserving all numbers; p=q=0 is retained as never-terminating. Fair 2/3 and random-first 1/2 follow.
- Bananas: while inventory exceeds capacity 50, two forward and one return traversal cost 3 per unit; at 50/3 distance inventory hits 50, then one-way cost gives 50/3 at destination. Integer 16m and 17m constructions both yield 16, bounded above by floor(50/3). Each shuttle reserves return fuel; no zero-cost return assumption.
- Binary coding: 2^9<1000<=2^10, unique codes 0..999; zero code requires exactly one abnormal bottle. Possible none requires another state; OR-collisions prevent naïve reuse for multiple abnormal bottles. Multi-time outcome counts remain upper bounds, not automatic constructions.
- Bulbs: factor pairing leaves only squares; independently checked n=0..100 and isqrt(Long.MAX_VALUE)=3037000499. Midpoint division needs positive divisor, as stated.
- Candy: C(18,9)=48620 agrees with sum C(10,k)C(8,k-1). Distinguishable, injective, positive-allocation and remaining-unallocated variants preserved. No mixing of these sample spaces.
- Coverage: unbounded radius and bounded target allow one disk; unbounded target cannot be covered by finitely many finite disks. Missing optimization constraints correctly block a unique number.

## Evidence limits and integration
`independent-math-checks.json` records new bounded Python checks, not the author's Java execution. These entries have no complete executable-code claims; module references are not proof of execution. No JVM, build or browser was launched. Whole compiled renderQA/qaCardHtml and actual pager were evaluated, retaining every question, full answer and lead; peripheral chrome/status helpers were stubbed. The composed 30-leaf alternative keeps ORIGINAL before guards, including one newly needed original lead guard. Apply it once instead of the author's 29-leaf proposal. Final integrated route, DOM/layout and regression acceptance remain the integrator's step.
